description: Notification sent to a user when they have been banned from a chat room. Bans persist across rejoin attempts until an admin lifts them.
subject: You've been banned from chat room "$room_name"
body:
Hello $user_name,

This is to let you know that you have been banned from the chat room "$room_name".

Details:
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Room:       $room_name
Action:     Banned
By:         $actor_name
Date:       $action_date
Reason:     $reason
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

What this means:
• You have been removed from the room and will not be able to rejoin or be re-invited until the ban is lifted.
• Any pending invitations you held to this room have been revoked.
• If you believe this was a mistake, contact the room admin shown above; they can lift the ban from the room's Manage Members → Bans… screen.

Kind regards,
University Communications

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
This is an automated notification. Please do not reply to this email.
